runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The needed matter surfaced in its file-name searches and scan, but it treated higher matter numbers as more recent, never opened that matter, and named a later-numbered one.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its file-name searches and scan listed the matter it needed (including an execution-version agreement), but it restricted its recency check to higher-numbered folders and listed or read only those candidates, never opening that matter.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the review at [36] flagged the number-range restriction and the review at [78] named the low-numbered range containing the needed matter as unopened; the agent finished without opening it.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way: the needed matter surfaced in their store-wide scans (and in T1/T2 also in file-name searches), but each ranked candidates by matter number or by the latest agreement dates it saw, listed and read only higher-numbered matters, never opened the needed matter, and named the same later-dated matter with a tax protection agreement (surfaced, never opened). Reviews flagged unopened candidates throughout, mostly naming higher-numbered ones; T2's final review named the low-numbered range, but the run finished without opening it.
